title: openai-curated-vercel-deploy
summary: --- name: vercel-deploy description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment". --- # Vercel Deploy Deploy any project to Vercel instantly. **Always deploy as preview** (not production) unless the user explicitly asks for production. ## Prerequisites - Check whether the Vercel CLI is installed **without** escalated permissions (for example, `command -v vercel`). - Only escalate the actual deploy command if sandboxing blocks the deployment network calls (`sandbox_permissions=require_escalated`). - The deployment might take a few minutes. Use appropriate timeout values.
type: skills
tags: openai, source-openai-skills
